verdicts.reason: A turns the design into a proper left-to-right banner: the logo sits on the left, and the headline sits on the right with the CTA stacked right under it, all readable and on brand. Its flaws are that the logo is oversized and pulls attention from the headline, the empty middle gap is a little wide, and a bokeh dot sits just past 'Light'. B squeezes the CTA into a narrow column with one or two words per line ('Shop / the / Summer / Line'), breaks the headline across two lines at a size that crowds the top and bottom edges, and shrinks the logo until it nearly disappears, so the spacing and hierarchy fall apart.
